Project__c.Auditor_Project__c: Indicates if this is an auditor project. Auditor projects have special handling and reporting requirements.
Project__c.Name: The official project name as it appears in Salesforce. This is the primary identifier for the project.
Project__c.Short_Project_Name__c: A shortened version of the project name used for display in compact views and reports.
Project__c.Contributor_Project_Name__c: The name of the project as it appears to contributors. This may differ from the internal project name.
Project__c.Appen_Partner__c: The Appen partner organization associated with this project (e.g., Appen, Appen China).
Project__c.Job_Category__c: The category classification for this job/project (e.g., Computer Sciences, Healthcare, Legal).
Project__c.Project_Short_Description__c: A brief description of the project (typically 1-2 sentences) used in summaries and listings.
Project__c.Project_Long_Description__c: A detailed description of the project including objectives, requirements, and scope.
Project__c.Project_Type__c: The type of project (e.g., Data collection, Translation, Transcription, Search Evaluation).
Project__c.Project_Priority__c: A numeric priority value for the project. Higher numbers indicate higher priority.
Project__c.Workday_Project_ID__c: The corresponding project ID in the Workday system for integration purposes.
Project__c.Project_Page__c: The project page identifier or URL associated with this project.

Project_Objective__c.Contributor_Facing_Project_Name__c: The name of the project as displayed to contributors for this objective.
Project_Objective__c.Project_Objective_Name__c: The official name of the project objective. This is the primary identifier.
Project_Objective__c.Append_to_Objective_Name__c: Additional text to append to the objective name for display purposes.

Qualification_Step__c.Name: The name of the qualification step.
Qualification_Step__c.Description__c: A detailed description of what this qualification step entails.

Project_Page__c.Name: The name of the project page.
Project_Page__c.Description__c: A description of the project page content and purpose.

Project_Workstream__c.Delivery_Tool_Name__c: The name of the delivery tool used for this workstream (e.g., A9, ADAP, Appen Collect).
Project_Workstream__c.Client_Workstream_Identifier__c: The unique identifier for this workstream in the client's system.
Project_Workstream__c.Functionality__c: The type of functionality this workstream provides (e.g., System Access, Productivity).
